style.vernacular: White-and-blue Mediterranean capital. The UNESCO medina has whitewashed courtyard houses, studded blue or green doors, green-tiled mosque roofs and square minarets; the French-built ville nouvelle (1880s-1940s) has 4-7 storey cream stucco Art Nouveau and Art Deco blocks with iron balconies along tree-lined avenues; newer districts are flat-roofed concrete and render, with glass towers around the lake.
style.ornament: Studded blue doors, mashrabiya-style grilles, horseshoe and pointed arches, Qallaline ceramic tile panels, carved plaster, green-glazed tile roofs and small domes, Art Deco geometric stucco on 1930s buildings.
